evidence: The primary market catalyst across the news flow on May 16 is the confirmation that the Luna Foundation Guard (LFG) has already liquidated virtually all of its 80,000+ BTC reserve, removing a massive overhang of forced selling pressure that triggered the prior week's market collapse. Furthermore, technical indicators note that Bitcoin has printed a record 7 consecutive red weekly candles, leaving the asset heavily oversold, while on-chain metrics show addresses holding >= 1 BTC reached fresh all-time highs amid accumulation in the $29,000-$31,000 range. While broader macro and bear-market headwinds remain severe, the exhaustion of catastrophic forced liquidations from Terra and extreme oversold conditions provide moderate support for a short-term 24-hour relief bounce.
limitations: All evidence comes from unverified crypto news outlets without primary tier-1 financial wire coverage.
Multiple articles report on the identical LFG reserve liquidation event and were clustered as a single primary signal.
